name: Gmail Assistant — Decisions

parameters.content:
## Inbox Pilot decisions
Every decision draft in Gmail links here.

**GET** (the link) shows what a choice will do. Nothing changes.
**POST** (the Confirm button) executes it.

The random token in each link is checked against **Inbox Pilot Decisions** and works once: anything not `pending` is refused.

Swap adds the new event and creates reschedule **drafts**. It never deletes events or sends mail.

description: Handles Keep/Swap/Add/Ignore and Book/Decline links from Inbox Pilot decision drafts: GET shows a confirmation page, POST executes. Single-use tokens; never sends mail or deletes events.
